primary_reason: Weather feature coverage over the real ingested window is only 27.1% (minimum bar: 80%). Stage 11D integrated NOAA GHCNh (a real official archive that DOES cover the transit window, confirmed by direct download) alongside NWS, roughly doubling coverage from Stage 11C's 13.5% -- but GHCNh's Boston Logan feed interleaves many partial reports (wind-direction-only, etc.) with fewer rows that actually carry temperature/precipitation/visibility together, leaving real gaps wider than the configured asof-join tolerance on many hours/days -- see data/interim/real/weather_coverage_report.json (coverage_by_date/coverage_by_hour) for the measured gap structure. No fabricated weather was substituted to close it.
